overview.value: SES describes itself as a global space solutions company. The company says that by transforming space into a platform for innovation, it delivers the connectivity that helps governments protect, businesses grow, and people stay in touch wherever they are. SES says it provides resilient, seamless connectivity and exceptional video content through an integrated multi-orbit network of around 120 satellites and a global terrestrial network.

focus.value: Communications satellite operator supplying video and data connectivity worldwide
